title: Nato to skip leaders’ summit in Albania next year as high-level meetings are scaled back
snippet: Nato is scaling back its high-level meetings and will not hold a leaders’ summit in Albania next year as previously planned amid tension within the alliance over defence spending, Iran and the war in Ukraine. Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama said on Thursday that “there is not yet a common position on when the summit will happen, for sure not in 2027”. He said that “in 2028, if it will be a summit, it will be in Tirana”, Albania’s capital. Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte played down the issue.

За отчетный период среди обнаруженных фальшивок оказалось 795 пятитысячных банкнот, 416 — тысячерублевых, а также 35 купюр номиналом две тысячи рублей.

Так господин Песков прокомментировал заявление председателя Еврокомиссии Урсулы фон дер Ляйен о том, что Европа будет представлена на переговорах по Украине в формате «Е5+ЕС».

title: Российские военные нанесли удар по объектам для хранения ГСМ в порту Николаев

title: California Sues OpenAI After AI Agents Repeatedly Went Rogue
snippet: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said Monday the state would sue OpenAI after its AI agents went rogue during testing, arguing the San Altman-led company illegally failed to maintain safeguards for its models. An OpenAI spokesperson did not respond to an immediate request for comment. More to come…
